newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Akzo buys skin product from Scholl.
newsitem.headline: Akzo buys skin product from Scholl.

text.p: Chemical group Akzo Nobel NV said on Tuesday its Chefaro unit had acquired the Septivon skin disinfectant product from Britain's Scholl Plc.

Akzo said Septivon was the leading skin disinfectant in France and that the acquisition was in line with Chefaro's strategy of securing strong brand positions in the major European markets for over-the-counter (OTC) pharmaceuticals.
Chefaro had become one of the fastest growing OTC suppliers in France following its takeover of Ardeval, it added.
Akzo gave no financial details of the acquisition but Scholl announced last week that it was selling the Septivon brand to Chefaro for 125 million French francs.
